title: Glessner's courtyard: the wing over the carriage passage, built to its drawing
items: The four windows above the passage out of the courtyard now stand where the 1963 measured drawing puts them. They are paired under long stone courses, not small separate lintels and sills.
The passage now has its stone lintel and the two rounded corbels under it, at the drawn width and height.
The downpipe on that wall moves to the corner where the drawing shows it, with its hopper head.
